sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《VT-SCC: Visual-text semantic alignment via multimodal guidance for unified staple crop organ counting》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】In extensive experiments on a diverse dataset comprising wheat (Triticum aestivum), maize (Zea mays), rice (Oryza sativa), and soybean (Glycine max), VT-SCC achieved a mean absolute error(MAE) of 3.28 and a root mean square error(RMSE) of 4.48, outperforming existing generic counters while remaining competitive with specialized models.

evidence.text: In extensive experiments on a diverse dataset comprising wheat (Triticum aestivum), maize (Zea mays), rice (Oryza sativa), and soybean (Glycine max), VT-SCC achieved a mean absolute error(MAE) of 3.28 and a root mean square error(RMSE) of 4.48, outperforming existing generic counters while remaining competitive with specialized models.
